mapper.sql: d.id, d.job_id, d.user_id, d.resume_id, d.status, d.status_remark, d.delivery_time, d.view_time, d.interview_time, d.offer_time, d.create_time, d.update_time, j.title as job_title, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.city, c.company_name, r.name as resume_name, r.phone as candidate_phone, r.email as candidate_email, r.education, r.school, r.skill
mapper.select: select count(1) from delivery where job_id = #{jobId} and user_id = #{userId}
select id, job_id, user_id, resume_id, status, status_remark, delivery_time, view_time, interview_time, offer_time, create_time, update_time from delivery where id = #{id}
select from delivery d left join job j on j.id = d.job_id left join company c on c.id = j.company_id left join resume r on r.id = d.resume_id where d.id = #{id}
